services.desc: Discover the timeless beauty of the Schooner Hindu, a 1925 gaff-rigged schooner steeped in history and charm. This classic vessel has been lovingly restored to offer elegant and historically rich sailing experiences. Our sunset sails find a balance between being tranquil and rowdy. In light of this we do not have a youth price for our sunset sails, and discourage those with small children from riding with us for our evening sail. Sail Through History on our 1925 Gaff-Rigged Schooner and experience Key West’s most breathtaking sunset on the water. Our two-hour sail offers the perfect balance of relaxation and lively camaraderie, complete with fine bubbles, wine, beer, and an elegant

blurb: Guests sail aboard the historic Schooner Hindu or the Cutter Bloodhound in Cape Cod Bay. Experiences include sunset sails and day sails with opportunities to see wildlife and coastal scenery. The company is family-owned and focuses on preserving historic vessels and sharing their stories.

quotes.text: Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google. Our sailing experience today was outstanding! Having all four sails up was wonderful. The boat gracefully sailed through the waters of Provincetown Harbor. The sight of the dolphins swimming through the harbor was an unexpected treat. Everyone on board was happy and just having the best time, thanks to the wonderful crew. Their passion for and joy of sailing was evident, making everyone feel welcomed throughout the trip. The Schooner Hindu staff provided a memorable day on the water!

Last week my daughter and I had the opportunity to sail with the crew of the Blood Hound. I am not overly fond of being on sailboats, but my concerns were quickly resolved by the laid back and talented crew. We spent our time sailing PTown Harbor talking about many subjects like the history of the BloodHound, the ecology of the Cape (Coastal Studies) and of course sailing. Next time down to Provinceton, we will definitely be trying out the Sunset Cruises.

Had so much fun sailing on the Hindu and can’t wait to go again. Felt like we were out with old friends who happen to have a beautiful boat. Our group ranged from ages 2 to 70 and everyone enjoyed themselves. It seemed breezy at the dock but once we were out of the harbor we had a really smooth cruise around the bay. Easily the highlight of our week on Cape Cod!

I come back time and time again for the beautiful sailboat, wonderful captain and crew and the sweetest dogs. You can’t find a more beautiful way to watch the sun set than to sail on the Bloodhound or the Hindu. Thanks for another great trip.

What a truly wonderful experience! From the friendly greeting on the dock, to the equally friendly captain and crew, this was by far the best sail I've enjoyed in a very long time. In a word, memorable.
